items.text: The coordinated case definition and dossier identify the candidate/configuration/date, received external evidence and agreed activity, cover all five assigned scope items and four named scenarios, and carry the applicable open choices to their named owners and points of need without selecting them. Verified by VER-001. Sources: BASIS; REQ-001; TBD-001…003.

verification.text: Inspect the case plan and dossier against BASIS scope/output/objective rows, EXM V4-EXM-20…23, received activity/configuration and the exact OPEN/PRD decisions. Reconcile source wording using AX-001 and verify the adopted basis rather than treating a proposed handoff as supplied.

items.text: The candidate evidence demonstrates the completed local-model V4-EXM-20 path on invented piping material: support/run-adjustment request, catalog reads, proposal in host tables with old/new values, some rows accepted individually, one rejected, application, following solve, origins and receipts; the live embedded request-to-acceptance witness passes on the identified App/SWBPIPE candidate. Mere definition, fixture passes or honest absence reports do not satisfy it. Verified by VER-002. Sources: REQ-002/008; EXM V4-EXM-20 and §7.

verification.text: Coordinate with the external SWB owner to observe the live embedded local-model journey on the actual candidate. Inspect catalog reads, model/table views, individual accepted rows and one rejected row, applied state, solve result, origins and receipts. Confirm the real request-to-acceptance completion and its App/SWBPIPE identities; separately retain failures and partial evidence.

items.text: The joined evidence traces original inspection basis through an intervening edit and stale refusal to actual application/outcome/receipt recovery; any redraft names its new basis, no selection silently retargets the proposal, and any unavailable outcome remains unknown. Verified by VER-003. Sources: REQ-003; SOW-239; HTML decisions 04/05.

verification.text: Examine the original read basis and an intervening model edit; observe stale refusal and its reason. Follow any explicit new-basis proposal to actual outcome and host receipt recovery, including interruption/unavailable-outcome observations relevant to that recovery. Check that a reconnect, returned transport success or selected object has not supplied a missing domain outcome.

items.text: After an engineer edit, V4-EXM-21 attaches agent findings by reference to rows/results without table mutation and retains their views, basis and standing. Findings and tool success do not fabricate human Checked/acceptance/approval/reliance or professional certification claims; a real human act is faithfully recorded with decision actor distinct from recorder and content/scope/purpose intact. Verified by VER-004. Sources: REQ-004/007; EXM V4-EXM-21; HOST V4-HI-31/32.

verification.text: Compare before/after host table content for the engineer-edit/check case and follow findings' references and result standing. Inspect fabrication negatives for absent human acts, and a positive faithful record of an actually performed scenario human act (such as row acceptance), including actor versus recorder and identified content/scope/purpose. Verify changed-content lapse where an actual content-bound act is affected. No additional favorable approval or professional act is demanded.

items.text: With the recorded adopted policy, V4-EXM-22 demonstrates one low-consequence operation class applied directly with origin/undo, geometry offered as proposals, visible run-recorded settings, and a workflow checkpoint holding for the person's act despite autonomy. No case result silently decides the unresolved reserved-act or classifier policy. Verified by VER-005. Sources: REQ-005; EXM V4-EXM-22.

verification.text: Inspect the actual adopted per-operation autonomy policy and run setting; observe the one allowed direct-operation class with origin/undo, geometry proposal behavior and workflow checkpoint hold/release only by the required actual human act. Verify the evidence does not manufacture policy adoption or infer one act from another.

items.text: All host network traffic throughout the V4-EXM-20 local-model journey is observed and shows no request to any destination other than the configured model server, with candidate-specific evidence of the actual native host endpoint boundary. Limited or unavailable observation remains incomplete qualification. Verified by VER-006. Sources: REQ-006; EXM V4-EXM-23; ARC V4-ARC-12.

verification.text: Receive and independently examine complete host-network observation for the same V4-EXM-20 candidate/run/configured endpoint and actual native enforcement evidence. Account for the observation boundary and any gaps; compare every observed destination with the configured model server. A partial capture or substitute fixture cannot pass the criterion.

items.text: One independently examined dossier links the cases and host receipts without replacing host truth, separates actual operations/outcomes/human acts, retains unknowns and limitations, records applicable WebKit/Chromium and targeted packaged/native evidence, and identifies which affected checks need reopening when the candidate changes. It is usable by App DEL-11-03 as the local-host contribution; it establishes no standalone App pass, replacement decision, public release or professional reliance. Verified by VER-007. Sources: REQ-007/008; CLM-001/003/005; EXM §§2,7.

verification.text: Independently reconstruct the joined local activity from the dossier and linked host evidence: request, proposal, human acts, changes, solve/checking, autonomy, checkpoint, traffic and recovery. Inspect configuration/outcome/limitation records, applicable browser and packaged/native coverage, changed-candidate applicability and the precise evidence supplied to App DEL-11-03. This is not the separate week-later V4-EXM-31 assignment.

items.text: The dossier's responsibility account resolves every excluded act in REQ-009 to its cited owner, distinguishes human-relayed proposals from received/adopted commitments and actual delivery, and preserves dependency/open-policy limits without holding independent App definition for the future live witness. Verified by VER-008. Sources: CLM-001…004; REQ-009; OPEN DEP-001; METHOD §6.

verification.text: Review the one-for-one act/owner account in REQ-009 against CLM-001…004 and the accepted external/open records. Separate prepared, relayed, received, agreed, delivered and examined facts using actual available evidence, preserving unknowns. Check no host construction, feature-local check, policy decision or human act is claimed from this coordination artifact alone.
